display.purpose: Hero and page titles only — high contrast, large-only.

prose.purpose: Editorial body: descriptions, bios, licence text.

eyebrow.purpose: Tracked gold overline above a headline.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for colour and border transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one gold CTA per screen — buy, submit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { direction: rtl; font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #14141A; background: #C8A24A; border: none; border-radius: 8px; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(200,162,74,0.35), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(200,162,74,0.45); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #D6B871; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C8A24A; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action; hover lifts the border, never to gold.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { direction: rtl; font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; color: #F5F2EA; background: transparent; border: 1px solid #33333D; border-radius: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { border-color: rgba(245,242,234,0.25); }

components.name: Price Chip
components.description: The only fully-rounded element on a card, so the eye lands on the number.
components.css: .ds-price-chip { direction: ltr; unicode-bidi: isolate; font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1rem; color: #C8A24A; background: rgba(200,162,74,0.12); border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px; }

components.name: Album Card
components.description: Catalogue card; hover lifts the border and scales the image, title never changes colour.
components.html:
العُلا — لقطات جوية

1,499 ر.س.
components.css: .ds-card { direction: rtl; background: #1C1C22; border: 1px solid #33333D; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,20,26,0.06), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(20,20,26,0.25); transition: border-color 0.3s; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(245,242,234,0.25); } .ds-card__media { aspect-ratio: 16/9; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#14141A,#26262E); } .ds-card__title { font-family: 'Thmanyah Serif Display', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; color: #F5F2EA; padding: 12px 16px 4px; margin: 0; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Header search; magnifier at inline-start via padding so it flips in RTL.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" dir="rtl" placeholder="ابحث عن لقطات… الرياض، العلا" />
components.css: .ds-input { direction: rtl; font-family: 'Thmanyah Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #F5F2EA; background: #14141A; border: 1px solid #33333D; border-radius: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; width: 100%; text-align: start; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A6A29A; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C8A24A; outline-offset: 2px; border-color: #C8A24A; }

narrative.northStar: The Cinema, Not the Vendor's Table
narrative.overview: Laqta is the Saudi stock footage library. The whole product lives inside the hero film — a dark, cinematic scroll built from the library's own footage — so the design is dark-first by conviction. The frame is the loudest thing on screen, the chrome recedes, and gold appears only where money and action are. The system is deliberately spare: one accent, one type family in three cuts, a handful of surfaces stepping up from ink. Restraint is the identity — the moment three highlights compete, nothing reads as premium, and premium is the entire pitch against a subscription library. Arabic leads everywhere; it is not a translation layer over a Latin design.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: the catalogue sits inside the film, ink is ~55% of any surface
One accent (gold), rationed to money / primary action / active state only
Thmanyah superfamily: Serif Display large, Serif Text for prose, Sans for UI
The letterbox (2.39:1) as the recurring geometry — the shape of the product
Generous margins; content holds the middle two-thirds

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Gold means money, the primary action, or the active state — nothing else. On any given screen gold covers well under 15% of surface. If two gold things compete for the eye on one screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Status-Only Colour Rule
rules.body: Oasis, clay and destructive appear only as state — a badge, an alert, a ledger sign. Never a brand accent, never a decorative surface.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Headline Rule
rules.body: A headline is one size set as two lines — a Light lead over a Bold statement. Arabic copy splits on its comma.

rules.name: The Isolated-Latin Rule
rules.body: Any Latin run inside Arabic is wrapped .ltr-island or .numeric. Dates and money go in an inner numeric span, never on a flex container, because flex breaks the isolation.

rules.name: The Tonal-Depth Rule
rules.body: Prefer stepping the surface tone (ink → card → muted) over adding a shadow. Shadows are for things that genuinely float.

dos: Do keep gold for money, the one primary action, and active state. Well under 15% of a screen.
Do set page titles in Serif Display, editorial prose in Serif Text, and every control in Sans.
Do use the two-weight headline where copy splits on a comma.
Do wrap every Latin run inside Arabic in .ltr-island / .numeric, and put dates/money in an inner numeric span, never on a flex element.
Do reach for a tonal step (ink → card → muted) before a shadow.
Do use the letterbox (2.39:1) for hero crops and empty states.
donts: Don't put gold on hover borders, heading hovers, non-price text, or stat figures that aren't money.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or a gradient; the palette is five earth values plus status.
Don't force 16:9 on a clip whose real aspect is 9:16 — it lies about the product.
Don't use left/right or ml/mr; logical properties only, or RTL breaks.
Don't let a status colour (oasis/clay/destructive) become a brand accent.
Don't ship a headline in Sans or a data table label in Serif Display.
